verdict.rationale: Simular documents Sai operating across the whole OS: desktop apps, browsers, file systems and terminals. It continues working after you close the laptop, pings you via iMessage/Telegram only when it needs you, and asks for approval only before sensitive actions. Saved workflows self-heal when a UI change breaks a step. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that long cross-app tasks actually complete unattended, and any published success-rate or reliability metrics beyond vendor claims.
